source_constants.name: APNAP
source_constants.pattern:
\#define\ APNAP\(playervar,\ \.\.\.\)\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\	do\ \{\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\	\	int\ playervar;\ int\ macro_apnap;\	/\*\ avoid\ comma\ \*/\	\	\\\
\	\	for\ \(macro_apnap\ =\ 0;\ macro_apnap\ <=\ 1;\ \+\+macro_apnap\)\{\	\\\
\	\	\	playervar\ =\ current_turn\ \^\ macro_apnap;\	\	\	\	\\\
\	\	\	\{__VA_ARGS__;\}\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\	\	\}\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\	\}\ while\ \(0\)

source_constants.name: IS_CASTING
source_constants.pattern: \#define\ IS_CASTING\(player,\ card,\ event\)\	\(event\ ==\ EVENT_CAN_CAST\ \|\|\ \(event\ ==\ EVENT_CAST_SPELL\ \&\&\ affect_me\(player,\ card\)\)\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_RESOLVE_SPELL\)

source_constants.name: IS_ACTIVATING
source_constants.pattern: \#define\ IS_ACTIVATING\(event\)\	\	\	\(event\ ==\ EVENT_CAN_ACTIVATE\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_ACTIVATE\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_RESOLVE_ACTIVATION\)

source_constants.name: IS_GS_EVENT
source_constants.pattern: \#define\ IS_GS_EVENT\(player,\ card,\ event\)\	\	\(IS_CASTING\(player,\ card,\ event\)\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CHANGE_TARGET\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CAN_CHANGE_TARGET\)

source_constants.name: IS_AURA_EVENT
source_constants.pattern: \#define\ IS_AURA_EVENT\(player,\ card,\ event\)\	\	\(IS_CASTING\(player,\ card,\ event\)\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CHANGE_TARGET\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CAN_CHANGE_TARGET\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CAN_MOVE_AURA\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_MOVE_AURA\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_RESOLVE_MOVING_AURA\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_POWER\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_TOUGHNESS\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CHANGE_TYPE\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_ABILITIES\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_SET_COLOR\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_GET_SELECTED_CARD\)

scope: One hundred complete October 2022 native card bodies reviewed:38 definitions updated and62 retained. Restore combat-AI accumulators and legal-attacker query, Slate of Ancestry discard cost, Exploding Borders spell events and land recount, Hivis duration-scoped control, Felidar Umbra reattachment, Drekavac hand selection, grave target interfaces, attack/spell dispatch, Horn of Plenty payer dialog, Goblin Tutor die wrapper, Daxos Spirit explicit power/toughness fields, fixed token colors and aura static events. Full aligned assembly resolves Daxos token fields, Shielded by Faith unchecked attachment/AI dispatch, Horn dialog controls, Manaforge Cinder actual mana output and radiant_damage physical specialization (five parameters, implicit trailing flags0). Native quirks retained including Alesha tracking all own attackers, Manaforge black-only mana declaration, Cenn counter threshold and Seeds of Renewal discard behavior. Original source names/interfaces/files preserved.169 callee identities,150 enum values,10 complete dependency bodies and87 native-data ranges pinned. Independent callee bodies and gameplay remain separately tracked; no byte matching or whole-program equivalence claim.
